title: The Block Cypher vol 1 - powered by Genzbuzz Events
description:
THE BLOCK CYPHER VOL. 1 🔥

The circle is calling. The Cypher Club brings you The Block Cypher Vol. 1, powered by GenzBuzz Events — a celebration of Hip-Hop, street dance, music and the culture that brings us together.

Whether you're a Breaker, Waacker, Popper, Locker, Krumper, Hip-Hop artist, DJ, dancer, or simply someone who loves good music, this block is yours.

Expect Cypher King & Queen, a special surprise category for Breakers, an electrifying guest showcase, live DJ sets, and a full-on Block Party atmosphere.

No fake hype. No boundaries. Just music, movement, community and raw energy.

Come dance. Come battle. Come watch. Come vibe.

THE BLOCK IS YOURS. 🖤🔥
things_to_know: 🎧 DJ — ARUN
Bringing the beats, turntablism and raw Hip-Hop energy to the block.
🎤 EMCEE — ROSHAN BANERJEE
Holding down the mic and keeping the circle alive.
🌟 GUEST SHOWCASE — MWG CREW
Get ready for a special showcase from MWG Crew.
🔥 SURPRISE BREAKING CATEGORY
Something different is coming to the Breaking scene — a surprise category that has never really happened in K-City before. 👀
🎟️ FREE REGISTRATION FOR BREAKERS
If you’re attending The Block Cypher Vol. 1, you can register FREE for the surprise Breaking category.
Attending the jam = Free entry to the surprise category.
👑 CYPHER KING & CYPHER QUEEN
Step into the circle. Show your style. Earn your crown.
🪩 AFTER-PARTY DJ — DJ REMO
The cypher doesn’t end when the battles do. We’re keeping the block alive with DJ Remo on the decks.
👕 DRESS CODE — MANDATORY
This is a BLOCK PARTY. Come dressed right — good clothes, good shoes and good energy.
🕺 WHO’S INVITED?
Breakers • Wackers • Poppers • Lockers • Krumpers • Hip-Hop Artists • Dancers • Music Lovers
Come for the cypher. Stay for the party.
THE BLOCK IS YOURS. 🔥
venue_address: The Myx Kolkata Park Street beside KFC parkstreet
terms: 1. Ticket Policy
All tickets purchased for The Block Cypher Vol. 1 are non-refundable and non-transferable unless otherwise stated by the organizers.
2. Entry
A valid ticket is required for entry. Attendees may be asked to present their ticket/QR code and a valid ID at the venue.
3. Dress Code
The dress code is mandatory. The organizers reserve the right to refuse entry to anyone who does not comply with the specified dress code.
4. Event Access
Your ticket provides access to the event as specified on the ticket. Entry does not automatically guarantee participation in battles, cyphers, showcases or any special category.
5. Surprise Breaking Category
The surprise Breaking category will be announced at the event. Participation is subject to the rules, eligibility and registration process announced by the organizers.
6. Free Registration for Breakers

Breakers attending the event with a valid event ticket may register free of charge for the surprise Breaking category. Free registration is available only to eligible attendees and does not include event entry.
7. Event Schedule
Event timings, artists, DJs, hosts, showcases, categories and activities may be changed, postponed or modified by the organizers due to operational or unforeseen circumstances.
8. Artist/Line-up Changes
The organizers reserve the right to make changes to the announced lineup, including DJs, emcees, performers or guest showcases, if required.
9. Venue Rules

All attendees must follow the rules and instructions of the venue and event staff. Any attendee engaging in misconduct, violence, harassment, damage to property or disruptive behaviour may be removed from the event without refund.
10. Prohibited Items
Weapons, illegal substances, dangerous items and any items prohibited by the venue are strictly not allowed. Security checks may be conducted at the entrance.
11. Alcohol & Substance Policy
Attendees must comply with applicable laws and venue policies regarding alcohol and prohibited substances. Anyone found violating these rules may be denied entry or removed from the event.
12. Personal Belongings
Attendees are responsible for their personal belongings. The organizers and venue are not responsible for lost, stolen or damaged personal items.
13. Photography & Videography

Photography and videography will take place during the event. By attending, you acknowledge that your image or likeness may appear in photographs, videos, promotional content or social media related to the event.
14. Safety
Attendees participate in cyphers, battles and dance activities at their own risk. Please follow safety instructions and respect other participants.
15. Respect the Culture

The Block Cypher is a celebration of Hip-Hop and street culture. Respect the dancers, artists, DJs, organizers, staff and fellow attendees. Discrimination, harassment, bullying or disrespectful behaviour will not be tolerated.
16. Organizer’s Rights
The organizers reserve the right to deny entry or remove any individual who violates these terms, venue rules or creates a safety/security concern.
17. Force Majeure

The organizers will not be liable for delays, cancellations or changes caused by circumstances beyond their reasonable control, including natural disasters, government restrictions, emergencies or other unforeseen events.
18. Acceptance of Terms
By purchasing a ticket and/or entering the event, you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.
The Cypher Club reserves the right to update these Terms & Conditions when necessary.
